notable_absence.finding: LCB_KEY_EEXISTS is reused here with the same code (272) and name as in advancedDeleteOp.json, but a different disambiguating sub-flag ('key_already_exists':true for a duplicate-key insert vs 'cas_mismatch':true for a CAS conflict on delete) and different desc text ('already exists in the server' vs 'exists with a CAS value different than specified') - the same libcouchbase error name is overloaded across two distinct failure conditions; worth the coordinator's attention as a naming/disambiguation nuance rather than a new error. The usual 'Version 7.1+/7.0+/6.6.1' server-version-string code-comment ladder recurs - flagged as recurrence of the known anomaly, not treated as new.
